botcomponent.description: A filter observation has 15 g dry dose, 225 g beverage, 250 g input water and TDS 0.0135 explicitly recorded as mass fraction. Calculate apparent beverage-based extraction yield. Then explain whether it can be calculated for another observation with no beverage mass. This is a simple arithmetic question, not a full study.
